title: Illustrations
slide_intent: Choose illustration when it clarifies a difficult subject because some ideas cannot be photographed directly.
strategic_value: A consistent illustration style can help Helsinki explain complex topics while retaining recognition.
demonstration: This webpage introduction names abstract, complex and hard-to-photograph subjects and explains illustration’s clarifying, enlivening and decorative roles.
practical_value: Decide whether illustration communicates the subject more clearly than a photograph.

content_islands.name: Illustration premise
content_islands.spec: Place the subject-selection rationale and consistency statement beneath the heading.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text connects illustration to clarification and a consistent style to recognition.
reference_purposes.Application: It names the kinds of subjects illustration can communicate.
